name: Dream Coworker
source: Hapless office worker Tim is stuck in the basement entering records with a coworker that wants nothing to do with him.  But then he  discovers “Dream Coworker” a mysterious application that allows him to mind control his annoying coworker as they sleep at night.  As you would expect, things take an immediate turn for the sexual.
